visual.description: Horizontal bar chart: 'Average Annual Salary (Nominal USD)'. 10 bars animate in from top (highest) to bottom (lowest). Bars use a single color (#90AFC5 muted blue). Countries: Switzerland, Luxembourg, Iceland, USA, Germany, Canada, Australia, UK, Spain, Mexico. Values are nominal (not PPP). No exact numbers in voiceover — just country names and ranking. The chart looks 'settled' and obvious. This is the setup before the PPP rug-pull.

notes: RAW SALARY SETUP. These are approximate nominal USD values (not PPP) — they exist only as a visual setup before the PPP rug-pull. Exact nominal values are NOT spoken in voiceover (only country names and relative positions). The bar chart will later re-sort when PPP is applied in scene-003. Values are rough estimates from OECD/Eurostat nominal data for visual purposes only.
